title: YouTube Pro controller note
description: Use the sidebar labels below to navigate the workspace.

research.label: Research
research.description: Search YouTube, compare public video data, generate grounded AI insights, and choose an idea.

script.label: Script Writer
script.description: Turn an idea into a script, then read it in the built-in teleprompter with play, speed, and text-size controls.

thumbnail.label: Thumbnail Creator
thumbnail.description: Create a thumbnail from one visual brief, an optional preset, and permitted reference images.

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: Connect local API keys and choose the Gemini text and image models.

newWorkflow.label: New Workflow
newWorkflow.description: Clear the current session after confirmation and begin again from Research.

recommendedOrder: Recommended order: Research, Script Writer, then Thumbnail Creator.
